name: TOTP Could Not Authenticate
description: Reports that the submitted authenticator code could not be accepted and offers deterministic recovery navigation without revealing additional account information.
notes: Try Again returns to auth.continue.totp for another authenticator-code attempt.
Start Over returns to auth.welcome and abandons the identified-account continuation state.
The public error surface must not disclose whether rejection was caused by mismatch, expiry, replay protection, or account lookup details.
